description: Every AI-supported recommendation is assessed against the overarching MiFID II obligation to act in the client's best interest.
name: acts_in_client_best_interest

description: Firms maintain comprehensive records on AI-related client and potential-client complaints.
name: ai_complaints_recorded

description: Information provided to clients on the firm's use of AI is presented in a clear, fair and not misleading manner.
name: ai_information_clear_fair

description: Ex-post controls monitor and evaluate any process that delivers information to clients directly or indirectly through AI-driven mechanisms.
name: ai_information_monitored

description: Ex-ante controls verify the accuracy of information supplied to or by AI before it is disseminated to clients, preventing erroneous or misleading investment advice.
name: ai_output_accuracy_controlled

description: Records document the use of AI, including the decision-making processes, data sources used, algorithms implemented, and any modifications made over time.
name: ai_records_maintained

description: AI systems are periodically stress-tested to evaluate performance under extreme market conditions.
name: ai_stress_tested

description: AI systems are tested and validated before deployment in the provision of investment services.
name: ai_tested_before_deployment

description: Firms transparently disclose to clients when they are interacting with an AI system (e.g. chatbots or other AI-driven automated systems).
name: ai_use_disclosed_to_client

description: Third-party AI used for critical or important operational functions is subject to MiFID II outsourcing due diligence and adequate controls.
name: outsourced_ai_due_diligence

description: AI-driven distribution aligns the products distributed to their identified target market (product governance).
name: product_governance_aligned

description: AI-supported recommendations are subject to a suitability assessment aligning them to the client's situation, objectives, sustainability preferences, risk tolerance, and knowledge.
name: recommendation_suitable

description: Staff using AI to provide information about investment products to clients do so under heightened vigilance and with adequate AI competence and training.
name: staff_competent_for_ai

description: Data used as input for AI systems is relevant, sufficient and representative, and algorithms are trained and validated on accurate, comprehensive and sufficiently broad datasets.
name: training_data_representative
